C1.title: Admin Catalog Controller Open & Index Sync Endpoint Security
C1.resolution: Applied ROLE_ADMIN requirement via SecurityConfig and @PreAuthorize. Secured FastAPI /api/index/sync with X-Service-Token header and removed arbitrary file path sync.

C2.title: Missing Storage Key Server Mapping & Path Traversal / Drive Resolution
C2.resolution: Implemented StorageKeyConfig with strict allowlist. Resolved Windows path containment and unmounted drive safety without crash.

C3.title: Partial JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Engine in Java
C3.resolution: Implemented complete two-step validation: Draft 2020-12 structural/type rules followed by relational/semantic validation matching validate_catalog.py.

C4.title: Under-specified Relational DDL & Missing Tables / Columns
C4.resolution: Updated schema.sql with complete 12 entity tables, raw_json CLOB preservation, opt_lock_version BIGINT, and catalog_snapshots outbox table.

C5.title: Contract Probe Failures on Valid Schemas
C5.resolution: Enhanced CatalogValidator and CatalogSyncManager to handle multilingual alias objects, unknown segment timestamps, and nested properties without false positives.

C6.title: Preview / Dry-Run Diff Calculation and Revision Conflict Detection
C6.resolution: Implemented validateAndPreview() computing SHA-256 and diff counts. Enforced revision conflict policy (rejecting lower revisions, detecting same-rev hash conflicts).

C7.title: Transaction Isolation, Optimistic Locking, and Outbox Snapshot Recording
C7.resolution: Implemented atomic transactional import across all 12 JPA repositories, @Version optimistic locking, and catalog_snapshots outbox persistence.

C8.title: Web Catalog Deep Linking, Race Condition, Click Trap & Accessibility
C8.resolution: Added deep link parsing (?episode=&scene=&asset=&t=), AbortController & generation counter on episode switch, multi-asset scene seek, removed click trap, added keyboard accessibility.

C9.title: FastAPI Hybrid Index Ingestion & Grounded Explanations
C9.resolution: Implemented 4-level catalog flattening, BM25 + multilingual-e5 hybrid indexing, and grounded Stage 5 explanations with timestamps and plot facts.

C10.title: Verification Artifacts, Runbook Update, and Snapshot Integrity
C10.resolution: Updated docs/runbooks/CATALOG_IMPORT.md, published field mapping matrix, resolution report, status, manifest, and cross review.
